snippet.title: Iron Onslaught Gameplay
snippet.description:
This is gameplay of my video game, Iron Onslaught. It's a wave-based game where you fight 2 enemies that grow in size for every new weapon you unlock. It's on Steam now, go check it out and see what you think about it 👍
